title: ginnania racemosa
intro: Ginnania racemosa, commonly known as Gynura, is a tropical plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Gynura include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Gynura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
